conventions.convention: H and the measurable instance space are nonempty. Shattering uses indexed tuples, repeated points retain separate coordinates, and the empty tuple is shattered. VC dimension takes values in the nonnegative integers or infinity.
The growth function maximizes trace cardinality over indexed m-tuples; its value at m=0 is one.
Empirical Rademacher complexity uses the one-sided supremum with normalization 1/m and independent uniform signs. C_VC is the explicit constant defined using K0=3e²/(e−1), K=4K0, and A=12eK+2.

A risk-measurable learning rule requires measurable population-risk and selected empirical-risk maps for the specified law P; empirical-infimum measurability is additionally required when used. PAC criteria quantify over every applicable law. No selector existence or computational claim is implicit.
The finite-class uniform-deviation branch is choice-free. The VC branch assumes AC and 1≤d≤m; all displayed suprema used in its argument are assumed measurable.

Entropy uniform convergence assumes AC and explicitly requires product measurability of deviation, ghost-sample, signed-difference, and signed empirical suprema for both the loss class and its complement.

The realizable guarantee assumes an already given risk-measurable rule that is consistent P^m-almost surely, together with measurability of the specified existential bad-sample and ghost-sample events. Its proof is choice-free.
Thresholds label x≤t by one; intervals are closed and bounded and allow a=b; affine halfspaces label score zero by one and have p≥1; the singleton-indicator class includes the zero function.
The interval class consists of indicators of closed bounded intervals [a,b] with a≤b, including degenerate intervals.
Affine halfspaces use h(x)=1 exactly when w·x+b≥0, including equality, and p is an integer at least one.
The singleton-indicator class on discrete N includes the constant zero function.

load_bearing.statement: A tuple is shattered when its trace is all binary label vectors; VCdim(H) is the supremum of shattered tuple lengths, including length zero.

For a nonempty measurable binary class H of finite VC dimension d, every fixed sample of size m≥1 has one-sided empirical loss Rademacher complexity at most C_VC√((d+1)/m), with the explicit stated constant. No countability or AC premise is used.

For a nonempty measurable binary class of finite VC dimension d and every integer m≥0, Π_H(m)≤Σ_{j=0}^d binom(m,j), with binom(m,j)=0 for j>m. Consequently Π_H(m)=1 for d=0, and Π_H(m)≤(em/d)^d when 1≤d≤m.

For a nonempty measurable binary class of finite VC dimension d, m≥1 IID observations, all four stated pairs of measurable supremum maps, and AC, with probability at least 1−δ the absolute uniform risk deviation is at most 2C_VC√((d+1)/m)+√(log(2/δ)/(2m)), for 0<δ<1.

Defines risk-measurable learning rules and consistent, exact-ERM, and finite-η approximate-ERM outputs for possibly infinite measurable binary classes; realizable and agnostic PAC probability criteria quantify over every applicable law.

concerns.concern: The Statement fixes a law P and imposes risk measurability and the four supremum-measurability conditions for that law, but concludes that “A is agnostic (ε,δ)-PAC on H.” The cited definition requires the probability criterion for every law P. The proof establishes the bound for the fixed admissible P; the global PAC conclusion needs the hypotheses to hold for every law, or an explicit qualification to admissible laws.

Verification 3.1 says “the traces are the empty vector and the m vectors with exactly one positive coordinate.” For m>0, the additional trace is the length-m zero vector; the empty vector has length zero and is not a trace on that sample. The intended count m+1 is correct.

seams_checked.note: The possibly infinite-class PAC definition explicitly extends the finite-class definition, preserves its realizable and agnostic probability criteria, and distinguishes risk-map measurability from measurability into a finite discrete hypothesis space. No finite-class selector-existence assertion is imported.

Read the active-learning page and its five listed items. The page declares this prerequisite but its items invoke no batch-4 result. Its concluding remark explicitly asserts no VC-dimension or distribution-free active label-complexity rate, so there is no strengthened use of a VC supplier.
